WhyChooseUs.title: Why people rebook with us
WhyChooseUs.sub: Four things we can actually stand behind — not a wall of generic checkmarks.
WhyChooseUs.trust1Desc: The price you're quoted on WhatsApp is the price you pay at pickup. Deposit and terms are explained before you confirm, not after.
WhyChooseUs.trust2Desc: A person answers, in French, English, or Arabic — usually within minutes, not a chatbot reading from a script.
WhyChooseUs.trust3Desc: Land at Menara, walk out of your medina riad, or meet us in Gueliz — we come to wherever your trip actually starts.
WhyChooseUs.trust4Desc: Every car is serviced and inspected between rentals — no rolling into your holiday with a check-engine light already on.

HowItWorks.title: How a request becomes a rental
HowItWorks.sub: Three steps, and a human confirms the details before anything is final.
HowItWorks.step1Desc: Filter by size, transmission, or price, and open the one that fits your trip.
HowItWorks.step2Desc: Fill out a quick form with your dates and pickup spot. No payment details required.
HowItWorks.step3Desc: We'll message you back to confirm availability and lock in the total price.
